circuit.name: Active Clamp Flyback DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Isolated flyback converter with active-clamp circuit for leakage energy recycling and ZVS operation. Converts 12V input to 5V isolated output. The clamp capacitor C_CLAMP in series with auxiliary switch SW_CLAMP forms a lossless snubber: when SW_MAIN turns OFF, leakage energy charges C_CLAMP through the SW_CLAMP body diode; when SW_CLAMP turns ON (complementary), the stored energy is returned to the primary, enabling ZVS turn-on of SW_MAIN. Improves efficiency and reduces EMI vs passive RCD snubbers.

requirements.requirement: Secondary output voltage regulation at 5V; verify isolation is maintained
Efficiency with clamp energy recycling; compare clamp capacitor voltage to estimate recycled power

outputs.description: Clamp capacitor average voltage (indicates stored energy level)

requirements.requirement: SW_MAIN peak voltage stress; active clamp should limit Vds_max to VIN + Vclamp

data.name: Vsw_main_max
data.description: Peak main switch drain voltage (should be VIN + Vclamp)
